questions.question_text:
A play starts at $7{:}10$ pm and lasts $2$ hours $5$ minutes.
When does it finish?

options.why: Adds the two hours but subtracts five minutes instead of adding them.
Subtracts the duration from the start instead of adding it.
Adds the hours but omits the extra five minutes.

questions.solution_text:
$7{:}10\text{ pm}+2\text{ h}=9{:}10\text{ pm}$
$9{:}10\text{ pm}+5\text{ min}=9{:}15\text{ pm}$

questions.question_text:
A tour finishes at $1640$ after lasting $1$ hour $55$ minutes.
When did it start?

options.why: Subtracts only 55 minutes and omits the full hour.
Adds the duration to the finish time instead of subtracting it.
Subtracts 45 minutes rather than 55 minutes after removing one hour.

questions.question_text:
A meeting starts at $10{:}35$ am and finishes at $1{:}15$ pm on the same day.
How long does it last?

options.why: Subtracts the hours to get $3$ and uses $35-15=20$ minutes without borrowing an hour.
Borrows an hour as $100$ minutes instead of $60$, giving $115-35=80$ minutes.
Converts $1{:}15$ pm to $12{:}15$ instead of $13{:}15$ before subtracting.

questions.question_text:
A coach leaves at $2340$ on Monday and the journey lasts $2$ hours $35$ minutes.
What day and time does it arrive?

options.why: Adds the $2$ hours but omits the $35$ minutes.
Subtracts $2$ hours $35$ minutes from $2340$ instead of adding them.
Adds the hours but fails to carry the hour from $40+35=75$ minutes.

questions.solution_text:
$23{:}40+2\text{ h }35\text{ min}=26{:}15$
$26{:}15-24\text{ h}=02{:}15$
The coach arrives at $0215$ on Tuesday.

questions.question_text:
A machine starts at $18{:}45$ on Wednesday and runs for $7$ hours $35$ minutes.
What day and time does it finish?

options.why: Adds the $7$ hours but omits the $35$ minutes.
Subtracts $7$ hours $35$ minutes from $18{:}45$ instead of adding them.
Adds the hours but fails to carry the hour from $45+35=80$ minutes.

questions.solution_text:
$18{:}45+7\text{ h }35\text{ min}=26{:}20$
$26{:}20-24\text{ h}=02{:}20$
The machine finishes at $02{:}20$ on Thursday.

questions.question_text:
A ferry must arrive by $0540$.
Sailing takes $2$ hours $48$ minutes and boarding takes $17$ minutes before departure.
What is the latest time boarding can begin?

options.why: Finds the sailing departure time but omits the earlier boarding period.
Adds the sailing time to the arrival deadline instead of subtracting it.
